question: What offerings are due to Caṇḍeśa at the conclusion of worship by the best priests?
premises: The worship sequence includes a concluding phase.
Food offerings and related items are designated for that concluding phase.
The best priests are the agents responsible for presenting offerings to Caṇḍeśa.
inference: Therefore the best priests must present the food offering and related items to Caṇḍeśa at the end of worship.
uncertainties: The specific items included under naivedyādyaṃ beyond food offering are not enumerated in this verse.
plain_english: O best priests, at the end of the worship present the food offering and so forth to Caṇḍeśa.
